Chemistry 2016-II.question: Which one of the following is not an allotrope of carbon?
Chemistry 2016-II.explanation: (d)  Eight allotropes of carbon: a) Diamond, b) Graphite, c) Lonsdaleite, d) C60 (Buckminsterfullerene or buckyball), e) C540, f) C70, g) Amorphous carbon, and h) single-walled carbon nanotube or buckytube. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

Chemistry 2016-II.question: Dolomite powder is applied in some agricultural lands. The purpose of applying it is to
options: increase the pH of the soil
lower the pH of the soil
increase the phosphorus content of the soil
increase the nitrogen content of the soil 167. Excessive use of which of the following fertilizers may be responsible for the presence of a toxic substance in groundwater?
Chemistry 2016-II.answer: increase the pH of the soil
Chemistry 2016-II.explanation: (a)  Dolomite is used in agriculture to raise the pH of overly acidic soil and provide nutrients for plants. It contains calcium carbonate and magnesium carbonate, two basic pH-raising ingredients that counteract the acids in soil and peat.

Chemistry 2016-II.question: In the gamma decay of a nucleus
options: the mass number of the nucleus changes whereas its atomic number does not change
the mass number of the nucleus does not change whereas its atomic number changes
both the mass number and the atomic number of the nucleus change
neither the mass number nor the atomic number of the nucleus changes
Chemistry 2016-II.answer: neither the mass number nor the atomic number of the nucleus changes
Chemistry 2016-II.explanation: (d)  Gamma decay, type of radioactivity in which some unstable atomic nuclei dissipate excess energy by a spontaneous electromagnetic process. In the radioactive substances, gamma decay occurs after the alpha and the beta decay. As the radioactive substance has already released some of its particles in the alpha and the beta decay it simply wants to release energy burst of electromagnetic radiations. The nuclei has comes to the stable state and releases energy in the form of gamma rays. In the gamma decay as no particles either protons or nucleons are released so the element before the radioactive gamma decay and after the gamma decay remains same.

Chemistry 2016-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-II.question: Which one of the following statements is correct?
options: The oxidation number for hydrogen is always zero.
The oxidation number for hydrogen is always +1.
The oxidation number for hydrogen is always -1.
Hydrogen can have more than one oxidation number.
Chemistry 2016-II.answer: Hydrogen can have more than one oxidation number.
Chemistry 2016-II.explanation: (d)  The oxidation state of hydrogen is +1 in its compounds, except for metal hydrides, such as NaH, LiH, etc., in which the oxidation state for H is –1.

Chemistry 2016-II.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-II.question: In case of a standard hydrogen electrode
options: absolute electrode potential is not zero
both absolute and standard electrode potential values are zero
electrode potential is zero only at 25°C
Chemistry 2016-II.answer: electrode potential is zero only at 25°C
Chemistry 2016-II.explanation: (d)  A Standard Hydrogen Electrode (SHE) is an electrode that scientists use for reference on all half-cell potential reactions. The value of the standard electrode potential is zero at 25°C, which forms the basis one needs to calculate cell potentials using different electrodes or different concentrations.
